module: Editor debug tool (Window > Vehicles > "Vehicle UI Textures" menu). It lists the vehicles, then the active HTML UI texture tags (CEF screens drawn on vehicles) of the chosen vehicle. For a tag, it lets you open/close the texture's console, export the texture as PNG and show the debug info (fps, size, usage mode, start URL).
notes: Vehicle methods used: getActiveUITextureTagNames, getConsoleOpenUITexture, openConsoleUITexture(tag, bool), dumpCEFTexture(tag, file), getActiveUITextureDebugInfo(tag).
The "Dump texture" button writes /vehicle_ui_<tag>_<UTC date>.png to the game's file system.
Bug: the code calls log("I", logTag, ...) while logTag is not defined in the file (nil unless a global logTag exists).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor hook called at initialization. Gets ui_imgui, registers the 'Vehicle UI Textures' window (520x420) and adds the menu entry in the 'Vehicles' group.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: draws the vehicle and tag dropdown lists, the console/dump buttons and the debug information.
